title: PAN
text:
All other PAN/s inadvertently allotted to you should be mentioned at item no. 11 of the form and the corresponding PAN card copy/s should be submitted for cancellation along with the form. [ Is there any third party verification conducted to verify identity and address of PAN applicants along with genuineness of documents submitted by them?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-08)
Yes. As per procedure prescribed by Income Tax Department, third party verification may be conducted to verify identity and address of PAN applicants along with genuineness of documents submitted by them during PAN application. If found fake, the Income Tax Department may take suitable action. [ What is e-PAN? Is e-PAN a valid proof of allotment of PAN?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-09)
e-PAN is a digitally signed PAN card issued in electronic form and it is a valid proof of allotment of PAN. [ Is e-mail ID mandatory for receiving e-PAN?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-10)
Yes. It is mandatory to mention valid e-mail ID in PAN application form to receive e-PAN. [ Is it compulsory to link Aadhaar with PAN?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-11)
Section 139AA of the Income Tax Act states that every person who has PAN as on July 1, 2017 is required to link his/her PAN with his/her Aadhaar number. Section 139AA also requires mandatory quoting of Aadhaar while applying for new PAN and also while filing return. [ What is the deadline to link Aadhaar with PAN?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-12)
Aadhaar-PAN linking deadline has been extended till March 31, 2022.
[ How do I link my Aadhaar with PAN?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-13)
(A) You may visit e-filing website of Income Tax Department [https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal ](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal%20) or Protean e-Gov TIN website [tinpan.proteantech.in](http://tinpan.proteantech.in/) and link your Aadhaar with PAN. (B) Alternatively, you can link your Aadhaar with PAN by sending SMS in the following format to 567678 – 
The format is: UIDPAN<SPACE><12 digit Aadhaar><SPACE><10 digit PAN>
For example, if your Aadhaar number is 111122223333 and PAN is AAAPA9999Q, then you are required to send SMS to 567678 as UIDPAN 111122223333 AAAPA9999Q 
This is a free service provided by Protean e-Gov. However, SMS charges as levied by the mobile operator will be applicable 
[ What should I do if I am unable to link my Aadhaar with PAN either online or through SMS facility as mentioned above?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-14)
You can link your Aadhaar with PAN using Biometric Aadhaar Authentication services. Click [ here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/Aadhaar_Seeding_Request_Form.pdf) to download Aadhaar Seeding Request Form and visit [**designated PAN centre**](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/List_of_TINFC-PAN_Centre_Biometric_27092019.xls) for Biometric Aadhaar Authentication along with supporting documents i.e. copy of PAN card and Aadhaar card. Unlike abovementioned online services, linking of Aadhaar with PAN using Biometric Aadhaar Authentication is chargeable. [ What is the new DigiLocker facility in the PAN application?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-15)
This facility allows you to securely link your DigiLocker account to your online PAN application.
